pipeline.environment_and_near_ground: Fixed OpenAI imagegen SDR plate; source and reference media omitted
pipeline.live_CG: Ball, conventional rounded eight-panel umbrella, closed 0.20 mm PVC, attached surface water and calibrated receiver/contact at the pre-revision checkpoint
pipeline.lighting: One shared authored SDR-derived radiance approximation, packed in master; not recovered HDR or measured photometry
pipeline.canonical_scale: 1 AU = 15/88 m; semantic authored calibration. Saved Blender unit scale is 1.0, not an applied conversion. Do not infer physical metres from that UI value or rescale the master blindly.
pipeline.saved_master_defaults: 450x300 and 48 samples remain saved; full-proof overrides are necessary and should not be written back to the checkpoint master
pipeline.denoise: OIDN 2.5.1 HDR/high on CPU, hero with actual albedo+normal guides; catcher color-only. Preserve original rendered alpha and leave plate untouched.
pipeline.display: AgX / AgX - Medium High Contrast, exposure 0, gamma 1, applied once

plate_inverse_limit.purpose: Display calibration only, not HDR recovery or a lossless inverse

pipeline.adapted_pipeline_status: Source-only AST/hash/plan validation; Blender/OIDN pipeline not executed
pipeline.reproducibility: Requires exact external packed master plus calibrated plate; no from-scratch scene builder or complete public reproduction
pipeline.determinism: No cross-machine bit-identical render guarantee; pinned input hashes identify inputs, not a completed output validation.
